title: A rule for every wing
lines: In the Wilds, after the boss in room 5 and after every boss after it, you pick one of 2 rules for the next 5 rooms. Both sides play by it: stumps on the board, a narrower or a longer table, fog, an early dusk, or more attack for a figure with nobody beside it.
Carrying on a raid in the Wilds from the front page first shows your room, the rule, the boss waiting and how the last room went, with Watch it again.
